decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY captures the fallback requirement but omits the explicit constraint against selecting a connector likely to be unavailable regularly.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Availability is my only concern. This premium option normally costs 1.46$, while typical ones are 0.4$; we can use it provided compatible alternatives exist if it goes out of stock, since I do not want a part that may be unavailable regularly.

value_updates.sourceability_requirement: The connector must remain readily obtainable; the proposed premium connector may be used only if compatible alternatives are available when it is out of stock, and it must not be likely to be unavailable regularly.

decisions.reason: The source decision concerns component availability and compatible sourcing alternatives, not I2C electrical parameters or pull-up placement.
The source decision does not change boost-enable control, pull-down resistance, powered loads, or sensor operation mode.
The connector sourceability decision does not alter any battery-protection behavior or protection mode.
